body: Automate This, ep. 7: never lose a lead in your inbox again.
Someone fills in your form. It sits in a busy inbox. You see it tomorrow and they've moved on.
The fix: n8n catches the form, AI scores the lead 1-5 with a one-line reason, the CRM record is created with notes, and anything 4+ pings you on your phone. The scoring prompt is on slide 4.
Pair it with episode 2 (auto-drafted replies) and you're answering in minutes. Slide 6 has the 4-step setup. Save it for the afternoon you build it.
